The caption explicitly states bilateral fibular hemimelia with left short femur, and in-text confirms complete fibular absence and Achterman-Kalamchi type II classification. The shortened femur is a manifestation of proximal femoral focal deficiency, which is also present but the primary disease attribution is fibular hemimelia. [raw subtype: type II (Achterman and Kalamchi)] B: Oblique radiograph of the left foot demonstrates deficiency of the fourth and fifth rays, only one cuneiform visible, and tarsal coalition.
